_source.title: 关闭内联框架窗口
_source.remarks.text.0: 关闭指定 ID 的内联框架窗口
_source.remarks.text.1: 注意：本接口仅扩展有效，在独立脚本环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.params.id: 内联框架窗口 ID，未传入时将关闭由本扩展打开的所有内联框架窗口

title: Close iframe window
remarks.text.0: Close the iframe window with the specified ID
remarks.text.1: Note: This API is only valid for extensions. Calling it in a standalone script environment will always `throw Error`
params.id: Iframe window ID. If not passed in, all iframe windows opened by this extension will be closed
